# Tech Boss (imtechboss.com) — AI Architecture, PC Hardware, Cybersecurity & Nepal Tech

> Official technology publication and engineering utility hub authored by Binod Bhatt (https://imtechboss.com). Covers frontier AI models, local LLM deployment (Ollama, LM Studio, GGUF quantization), PC hardware & GPU benchmarks, Windows 11 & Linux engineering fixes, cybersecurity defense, and Nepal-specific developer & hardware guides.

## 17 Interactive Engineering & AI Tools
- [Tech Boss Tools Hub](https://imtechboss.com/tools/): All browser-based calculators and developer utilities.

- [Local AI Electricity Cost Calculator](https://imtechboss.com/tools/local-ai-electricity-cost-calculator/): Estimate power draw and cost for self-hosted LLM rigs.
- [PC Bottleneck Calculator](https://imtechboss.com/tools/pc-bottleneck-calculator/): Analyze CPU/GPU balance across 1080p, 1440p, and 4K targets.
- [PC Power Supply (PSU) Calculator](https://imtechboss.com/tools/pc-power-supply-calculator/): Size ATX 3.1 / 12V-2x6 power supplies safely.
- [Can My PC Run It Checker](https://imtechboss.com/tools/can-my-pc-run-it/): Match hardware specs against modern PC game requirements.
- [GPU Matcher Quiz](https://imtechboss.com/tools/gpu-matcher-quiz/): Interactive GPU selection helper by workload and budget.
- [SSD NVMe PCIe Speed Calculator](https://imtechboss.com/tools/ssd-nvme-pcie-speed-calculator/): Compare Gen 3, Gen 4, and Gen 5 real sequential throughput.

- [AI Prompt Studio](https://imtechboss.com/tools/ai-prompt-studio/) & [JSON / JWT / Cron Dev Toolkit](https://imtechboss.com/tools/json-jwt-cron-dev-toolkit/).
